'''''Star Wars: Legacy'' Volume 2''', alternatively styled as '''''Star Wars: Legacy'' Volume II''' or simply '''''Star Wars: Legacy''''', is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] set in the [[Legacy era]]. It is a sequel to and shares a name with the original ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.<ref name="cbr interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/exclusive-hardman-and-bechko-resurrect-star-wars-legacy|text=EXCLUSIVE: Hardman and Bechko Resurrect "Star Wars: Legacy"|author=Jeffrey Renaud|work=[[Wikipedia:Comic Book Resources|Comic Book Resources]]|archivedate=20210227211423}}</ref> Written by [[Corinna Bechko]] and [[Gabriel Hardman]], penciled by Hardman,<ref name="CBR" /> colored by [[Rachelle Rosenberg]],<ref name="Solicitation" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]], it stars [[Ania Solo]], a descendant of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. The [[Legacy (2013) 1|first issue]] was released in [[March]] [[2013]].<ref name="Solicitation" /> The series ended with issue #18, as [[Marvel Comics]] replaced Dark Horse as the publisher of ''Star Wars'' comics.
